title: Council Hears Petition on Western Bridge Toll
summary: Carriers say the evening charge has outlived the repairs it was meant to fund.
author: Mara Bell, Civic Desk
paragraphs: The Council heard a petition from the Western Carriers' Association on Thursday concerning the additional toll collected after dusk. The charge was introduced to pay for the bridge's ironwork, which the borough engineer certified complete in the spring.

Several traders reported taking the longer quay road rather than paying the toll twice in one evening. Their evidence was disputed by the toll keeper, who said the last quarter's receipts were insufficient to meet the cost of lamps and patrols.
Councillor Vale asked for a separate accounting of repairs, lighting and watchmen before any vote. He also requested a count of pedestrians, whose fares have remained unchanged throughout the work.
The committee will receive the figures next week. Until then the present rates remain in force, and the petitioners have agreed not to obstruct the collection booth.
